feeds.title: IDIOTEQ » Hardcore
feeds.description: IDIOTEQ is an independent magazine supporting DIY ethics and local artists. Get inspired, and explore lesser-known talents and their perspective. Reporting on DIY music is its priority. They keep the reader posted on the latest news, new music, new stories, interviews, exclusive streams, music videos, tours, and much more.

feeds.title: Hardcore Punk
feeds.description: The author of the blog Hardcore Punk, is 51 years old, listening to hc/punk since 1982, and fanzine black side 1987-1998. The blog is solely dedicated to the hardcore genre. It features music reviews from the beginning of the genre to date.

feeds.title: This is kawaii not hawaii
feeds.description: This is Kawaii not Hawaii is a blog containing various personal hardcore punk records and k7s. The author shares punk hardcore ddl !!

feeds.title: The Hard Times » Punk/Hardcore
feeds.description: The Hard Times' takes on all things funny and punk. Find hard-hitting satirical headlines and articles that make you think and laugh. The Hard Times is a satirical punk news website made by a group of punk and hardcore kids from all the different sub-genres of the DIY hardcore scene.

feeds.title: THOUGHTS WORDS ACTION
feeds.description: THOUGHTS WORDS ACTION is a music review blog dedicated to the punk rock genre and related subgenres. Follow along as they dive into the latest releases and album premieres, and review and rank rock albums by your favorite bands. Discover more interesting resources on Punk Rock through their blog.

feeds.title: Transcended Music » Hardcore
feeds.description: Transcended Music are just a bunch of friends who expanded the idea of talking about music and put their passion for music into this blog. The main focus lies on heavy and fast music, predominantly coming from Punk / Hardcore / Metal since this is the common ground between all authors.

feeds.title: Louder Than War » Hardcore Reviews
feeds.description: Louder Than War is a music, culture, and media publication headed by The Membranes & Goldblade frontman John Robb. Online since 2010, it is one of the fastest-growing and most respected music-related publications on the net. Read the latest hardcore reviews from the writers & contributors at Louder than War - the home of music and culture.

feeds.title: Alternative Press » Hardcore
feeds.description: Alternate Press is a publishing company that keeps you posted on the music industry. On their website, you will find the latest news on music, style, culture, meta and more. Readers can also find interesting articles on hardcore music and other genres.

feeds.title: Metal Odyssey » hardcore
feeds.description: Metal Odyssey is a blog focusing on the music scene in the industry, written by Stone. The blog contains articles and reviews along with some artist interviews. The blog is categorized into various categories based on the different genres.

feeds.title: Theprp
feeds.description: Since 1999 Theprp.com has been the home to the latest news and reviews from the heavy music scene. For over fifteen years Theprp.com has been providing relevant, metal, hardcore, hard rock, etc. news, reviews, release dates and more to a strong and diverse community of readers.

feeds.title: Flying Fiddlesticks Music Blog » Hardcore
feeds.description: Flying Fiddlesticks Music Blog is dedicated to music for its own sake. They write recaps and reviews of music festivals and shows to promote live music as a life-improving experience. They cover new music releases and conduct interviews with artists to help get the word out.

feeds.title: Louisville Hardcore
feeds.description: Louisville Hardcore is a website that covers music in all genres and related information. Find information on Louisville's Punk, hardcore, and Indie rock scenes., flyer archives, upcoming shows, a complete history and more.

feeds.title: Unite Asia
feeds.description: Unite Asia is a punk, hardcore, metal website dedicated to showcasing Asian bands and happenings. The main inspiration for this website is the dearth of information about Asian bands and what they're up to.

feeds.title: Markus' Heavy Music Blog » Hardcore
feeds.description: Markus' Heavy Music Blog is a 100% non-commercial blog and everything that's posted on the blog is purely based on Markus's passion for rock and metal music. Photography was always something that excited him and the blog helped a lot to improve his concert photography competence.

feeds.title: Decibel Magazine » Hardcore
feeds.description: Decibel Magazine is the world's foremost heavy metal authority. It offers comprehensive oral histories of the greatest metal albums of all time. It features exclusive music from your favourite artists in the form of previously unreleased tracks, covers, live songs, demos, alternate takes, re-recordings and more. Also, its website contains archives dedicated to music genres.

feeds.title: Noob Heavy » Hardcore
feeds.description: Noob Heavy was started in March of 2019 by Carcassbomb. Melinda (Carcassbomb) is a writer, podcaster, and editor. She writes reviews, and interviews and hosts various other features on the site. She compiles the Free Bandcamp Wiki and the Commissioning Artist List. She also writes the Free Flush column covering NYOP Bandcamp releases at Toilet Ov Hell.

feeds.title: Nine Circles » Hardcore
feeds.description: Nine Circles is a team-run blog dedicated to heavy metal music of all types. It includes unique columns, daily news recaps, reviews, profiles, interviews, podcasts, photography, and, of course, strong personalities and opinions. It's irreverent, banter-filled coverage of the genre they know and adore.

feeds.title: Kerrang!
feeds.description: Kerrang! is the world's biggest-selling weekly rock music magazine, and represents a global community of musicians and fans alike. It is a staunch supporter of fresh talent and is also home to the biggest names in metal, punk and alternative music as a whole.

feeds.title: Outburn Magazine
feeds.description: Outburn Magazine is the leader of the new music revolution. Outburn Online is at the forefront of everything rock, metal, punk, hardcore, indie, and more.

feeds.title: V13.net » Hardcore/Punk
feeds.description: V13.net is a leading web destination for all things 'heavy music' inclusive of Alternative, Rock, Punk, Hardcore, Metal, and Indie coverage. It also covers music, film, TV, documentaries, pop culture, and socio-political stories.

feeds.title: AMP webzine » Hardcore Punk
feeds.description: AMP webzine is written by Vasco T Rodrigues. It was created to announce, support and portray what is happening in the amplified underground, with greater weight in Metal, punk and hardcore, it comes to fulfil a certain void of ideas in the medium but also to become another voice coming out of the shadows, praising quality which fortunately springs from these musical styles that are always forgotten or marginalized.

feeds.title: Indie Vision Music » Hardcore Punk
feeds.description: Indie Vision Music is a website that features news, reviews, interviews, and more on music. Their archives feature articles on music genres such as hardcore, punk, pop, hip-hop, and more.

feeds.title: Real Gone » Hardcore Punk
feeds.description: Real Gone is a blog that features articles on music genres such as pop, rock, metal, punk, opinionations, and other junk.

feeds.title: Science of Noise » Hardcore Punk
feeds.description: Science of Noise likes rock and metal in all their aspects and they want to support the scene, without competition, from a fresh and carefree perspective. They want to be independent and fair while still supporting all those who we believe deserve it. They have categorized their collected information into sub-categorise based on the genre.

feeds.title: IDIOTEQ
feeds.description: IDIOTEQ is a DIY online magazine covering some of the hardcore punk and rock music scene and supporting DIY ethics and local bands. Gather exclusive interviews, new music premieres, tour dates, news stories and event details, and more.

feeds.title: DezFlight
feeds.description: DezFlight‑Underground is a blog dedicated to sharing rare and hard-to-find underground and hardcore rap/hip‑hop albums, instrumentals, and compilations from around the world in high-quality MP3 format

With features like 'Song of the Week,' live show write-ups, and reflections on bands pushing sonic aggression, the blog highlights everything from heavy riff-driven chaos to boundary-breaking hardcore energy.

feeds.title: I Hate The 90s
feeds.description: I Hate The 90s is a passionate, indie music blog focused on the 1990s' alternative, punk, shoegaze, pop-punk, math rock, hardcore, and other underground genres.

feeds.description: Latest Articles & Reviews

feeds.title: Distorted Sound Magazine » Hardcore

feeds.title: Wonderbox Metal » Hardcore
feeds.description: Wonderbox Metal is aiming to promote the best that Metal music has to offer. Based in the UK, we specialise in metal album reviews, along with the occasional interview, premier, list, etc.

feeds.title: Hardstyle Mag » Hardcore

feeds.title: HandwrittenMag » Hardcore

feeds.description: Find thousands of DIY hardcore punk and punk-adjacent music reviews. We cover a diverse range of genres, including hardcore punk, crust, d-beat, metal, grindcore, emo, screamo, political hip-hop, noise, ambient, and experimental music.

feeds.title: La Mort D'Un.e. Moderniste
feeds.description: La Mort D'Un.e. Moderniste blog is dedicated to Hardcore punk and all related to it (subgenres, fusions, offshoots, variants, etc.). Sometimes they do post other musical genres.

feeds.title: Mosh Elsley
feeds.description: Robi Wan is the author of the blog Mosh Elsley. He started this blog to get people to discover music he likes and has a way to listen to it for free. He loves to talk about the noise he is listening to and maybe have a discussion or two.

feeds.title: HARDCORE PUNX
feeds.description: HARDCORE PUNX is a blog focused on punk and hardcore from the 80s until today. Whether English, German, Spanish, or Finnish vocals. Whether vinyl, tape, or CD.

feeds.title: All Things Old School
feeds.description: All Things Old School reviews, posts download links, and news mostly on old-school hardcore music worldwide.

feeds.title: The Predatory Wasp » Hardcore

feeds.title: The Sleeping Shaman » Hardcore
feeds.description: The Sleeping Shaman brings you the latest news, reviews and interviews from the 'heavier than thou' underground. On their website, readers can find the latest news, features, album and EP reviews, interviews, and more.

feeds.title: BrooklynVegan » Hardcore
feeds.description: Founded in 2004, BrooklynVegan is a NYC-centric, multi-genre, mostly music blog that focuses on international music news, album and live show reviews, pictures, festivals, tour dates, gossip, tips, song and album streams, videos, industry and tech news, special events and much more. Non-music stuff finds its way onto their pages as well including comedy, TV, movies, and burlesque, and every post comes with an open exchange of ideas via the public commenting system and social media.

feeds.title: Ital Massive » Hardcore

It is also an unofficial collective of artists and creators that have been brought together by an unapologetic music fanatic known as MRVN. Articles, news and reviews on various music genres such as hardcore, metal, punk, rock, pop, and more.
